<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This guide will go over how to complete the Combat achievements for The Magister, and assumes you are already familiar with the basic mechanics of the encounter which can be found here </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="the-magister-master-speed-killer"><ins><nowiki>The Magister Master Speed Killer</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Defeat the Magister in less than 0:12.0</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You should </nowiki><strong><nowiki>NOT</nowiki></strong><nowiki> use these rotations for standard kills, only for the achievement.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
